title: Tuple left fibration satisfies the generalized operad axioms
statement:
Use the universes, Kan spaces and specified tuple relative nerve of [def-coef-complete-algebroid] and the space-valued left-fibration classification of [lem-coef-space-transport-classification]. Fix a small Kan space $X$. The left fibration
$$\Delta_X^{\mathrm{op}}\longrightarrow\Delta^{\mathrm{op}}$$
classified by the functor $[n]\mapsto X^{n+1}$ is a generalized nonsymmetric infinity operad in the convention of [lem-coef-operadic-algebra-presentability]. Its degree-zero fibre is the Kan space $X$; inert maps have cocartesian lifts; and for every $n$ the Segal map to the product of the consecutive edge fibres over the shared vertex fibres is an equivalence (with the zero-edge case the identity of $X$). For every $[m]\xrightarrow{\phi}[n]$, source tuple $a$ and target tuple $b$, the mapping space over $\phi$ is the path space from $\phi_*a$ to $b$ in $X^{n+1}$. The incidence diagram formed from all vertex and consecutive-edge inert projections has limit equal to this path space, coordinate by coordinate. These assertions remain valid when $X$ is empty and when $n=0$.
